messages:
Anya: quick sync — we need to lock the API contract sweep for chat/completions/embeddings/rerank before roadmap review next week. proposing scope: acceptance criteria per endpoint, minimal edge cases, rollout plan + feature flags. can people call out hard constraints?
Mike: tl;dr: target GA parity with Dedicated behaviors for enterprise. my top constraints: streaming 99p < 800ms for <=256 tokens, embeddings dims/version stable, rerank deterministic tie-breaker. also need rollout SLOs.
Julia: from runtime pov: quantization-induced diffs are real. acceptance criteria should include: responses within a small distance to baseline for 95% of prompts. expose header `X-Compat-Mode: true` for deterministic kv-cache behavior. default max_batch=64.
Kevin: ml notes: for rerank we need a canonical eval set + target NDCG@5 >= baseline. for chat completions add hallucination checks on a curated anchor set. recommend 5% holdback for quality monitoring during rollout.
Sarah: devex asks: SDK changes needed — new param `response_mode` with `blocking|stream|hybrid`, stable error codes and error metadata (`code`, `retry_after`, `quota_id`). update examples and changelog.
Oliver: commercial ask: include `customer_label` in request metadata surfaced to console + logs, and export the specific `model_variant` used per response for audits. enterprise customers will require this for compliance.
deploy-bot: deploy started: branch=api-contract-sweep build=992 -> SUCCESS :white_check_mark:
Anya: ok actionable: PRD must contain acceptance bullets, minimal RFC for eng, e2e test plan, and canary rollout schedule. propose rollout cadence: 1% day1, 5% day2, 25% day3, 100% day7. who owns PRD?
Mike: i'll own the PRD draft. julia/kevin please give acceptance numbers by EOD thu. sarah to update SDK docs + examples. oliver plz capture enterprise must-haves.
Julia: one edge case: function-calling + streaming interleaving — we need an explicit KV eviction policy in the RFC (how we drop partial tool call tokens). otherwise clients will see weird partial-tool results.
Kevin: also add rerank qps limits (per-key) and backpressure signals (HTTP 429 + `Retry-After`). define how we degrade to cheaper model variant automatically.
Anya: sounds good. Mike, can you create the RFC thread and checklist? i'll slot PRD into next week's roadmap review.
Mike: will do — created RFC draft: https://redwood.internal/rfc/723 (rfc-723). rough acceptance snippet placed there. comments inline welcome.
Mike: snippet from PRD (will expand):
```
Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Chat streaming: 99p token latency < 800ms for 90% of production buckets for prompts <=256 tokens
- Completions: deterministic function-calling for identical prompts when `X-Compat-Mode=true`
- Embeddings: stable vector dimension and cosine variance < 0.02 vs baseline across eval set
- Rerank: NDCG@5 >= baseline on canonical eval set; deterministic tie-breaks; 5% holdback pass
- SDK: new `response_mode` param available in stable SDKs; error schema unchanged except documented new fields
```
Oliver: i'll attach the enterprise checklist to the RFC (data residency, audit logs, model_variant export).
Sarah: i'll open the SDK PR after mike posts the PRD link. will add code examples for `response_mode=hybrid`.
Julia: note for eng: make sure `max_batch` can be overridden per-route. some enterprise workloads need small batch sizes to avoid latency spikes.
Kevin: ml follow-up: we'll provide an eval report and a short regression checklist. will push to the RFC by tomorrow.
Anya: perfect. summary + owners: Mike=PRD author, Julia/Kevin=acceptance numbers + RFC edits, Sarah=SDK doc + PR, Oliver=enterprise checklist. follow-ups due EOD thursday. reactions appreciated :thumbsup:.
Mike: created checklist items in RFC and added canary schedule. pinged eng-runtime and eng-ml for reviews.
Julia: :thumbsup:
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Oliver: noted :ok_hand:
Anya: thanks everyone — i'll brief roadmap reviewers on friday.
